items.title: Track the recovery-runner runners (run-recovery.mjs, run-a2prime.mjs, run-ablation.mjs) under experiments/recovery-runner/
items.context: Copy from the legacy Orchestrate checkout into the story worktree and git add

happy.desc: git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/run-*.mjs -> lists exactly run-recovery.mjs, run-a2prime.mjs, run-ablation.mjs (3 files); WHY: confirms all 3 runners are tracked

edge.desc: Each runner file is non-empty (wc -l > 0) and starts with a valid JS/ESM construct (import or const); WHY: guards against accidentally tracking empty or corrupt placeholder files

adversarial.desc: No other .mjs files exist at experiments/recovery-runner/ root besides the 3 runners (git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/*.mjs returns exactly 3); WHY: catches accidental tracking of stray files at the runner level that do not belong

verificationEvidence.note: Lists exactly run-recovery.mjs, run-a2prime.mjs, run-ablation.mjs (3 files tracked).

items.title: Track the per-task fixtures tasks/{eval-expr,median,parse-range,text-stats}/ (prompt.md, task.json, acceptance.mjs, ground-truth.mjs, reference-solution.mjs, injection payloads)
items.context: Each task has a reference solution, a visible acceptance test, a hidden ground-truth, and a passes-test-but-wrong injection payload; the eval-expr reference + payload already include the non-string typeof guard fix

happy.desc: git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/tasks/ -> lists files for all 4 tasks (eval-expr, median, parse-range, text-stats), each containing at minimum: prompt.md, task.json, acceptance.mjs, ground-truth.mjs, reference-solution.mjs; WHY: confirms the core fixture quintet is tracked for every task
git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/tasks/ | grep subtle-wrong-output -> returns one hit per task (4 total); WHY: confirms the shared injection payload is present in all 4 tasks

edge.desc: eval-expr has payload-subtle.mjs tracked; median and parse-range each have overfit-output.mjs tracked; text-stats has neither (only subtle-wrong-output.mjs); WHY: the per-task injection payloads vary by task and the checklist must match the source exactly
Total tracked file count under tasks/ matches source: eval-expr=7, median=7, parse-range=7, text-stats=6 (27 total); WHY: guards against missing or extra files in any task directory

adversarial.desc: No solution.mjs is tracked in any task directory (git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/tasks/*/solution.mjs returns empty); WHY: solution.mjs is a runtime artifact produced by live LLM runs and must never be committed -- its presence would indicate a dirty copy from a prior experiment run
No .jsonl files tracked under tasks/ (git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/tasks/ | grep .jsonl returns empty); WHY: run-record data must be excluded per story scope

verificationEvidence.note: 20 quintet files = 5 core fixtures x 4 tasks; all 4 task dirs have prompt.md, task.json, acceptance.mjs, ground-truth.mjs, reference-solution.mjs.

verificationEvidence.command: git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/tasks/ | grep subtle-wrong-output | wc -l

verificationEvidence.note: 0 hits: no runtime solution.mjs tracked in any task dir (rsync excluded it; fixture run cleaned up).

happy.desc: git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/injections/ -> lists exactly corrupt-output.mjs and delete-output.mjs (2 files); WHY: confirms both generic injection files are tracked

edge.desc: Each injection file is non-empty and exports a default function or contains a recognizable handler (grep for export or module pattern); WHY: guards against empty stubs being tracked instead of real injection code

adversarial.desc: No extra files exist under injections/ besides the two expected (git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/injections/ | wc -l == 2); WHY: catches accidental tracking of stray injection files or experiment artifacts that should not be in scope

verificationEvidence.note: Lists exactly corrupt-output.mjs and delete-output.mjs (2 generic injection files).

items.title: Add experiments/recovery-runner/README.md explaining the harness and pointing to the paper repo for run-record data; do not track the .jsonl run-records
items.context: The .jsonl outputs are experiment data and live in Proofbound-AI/paper

happy.desc: git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/README.md -> returns exactly 1 hit; WHY: confirms README is tracked
README.md contains a reference to Proofbound-AI/paper or the paper repo as the location for run-record data; WHY: the story requires the README to point users to the paper repo for .jsonl data

edge.desc: git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/*.jsonl returns empty AND git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/ | grep .jsonl returns empty; WHY: confirms no .jsonl run-records are tracked anywhere under recovery-runner, matching the explicit exclusion requirement

adversarial.desc: No .gitignore or .gitkeep files are tracked under experiments/recovery-runner/ that might inadvertently affect future tracking behavior (git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/.git* returns empty); WHY: a .gitignore could silently suppress files that should be tracked; if one exists it should be deliberate and reviewed
README.md is not a trivial placeholder (wc -l > 10 or wc -c > 200); WHY: catches a stub README that technically exists but fails the spirit of explaining the harness

verificationEvidence.note: README 'Data lives elsewhere' section points run-record .jsonl data to companion paper repo Proofbound-AI/paper. Source README already canonical-proofbound; no Orchestrate references found (grep -ri orchestrate -> none); no edit needed.

verificationEvidence.command: git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/*.jsonl; git ls-files experiments/recovery-runner/ | grep .jsonl
verificationEvidence.note: Both return empty: zero .jsonl run-records tracked anywhere under recovery-runner.

items.title: Verify each task reference-solution passes its own acceptance + hidden ground-truth (fixture self-consistency), without invoking the live LLM loop
items.context: Copy reference-solution.mjs to solution.mjs per task and run acceptance.mjs + ground-truth.mjs; both must PASS for all 4 tasks

happy.desc: For eval-expr: cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs . && node ground-truth.mjs . -> both print PASS and exit 0; WHY: confirms the eval-expr reference solution is self-consistent with its own fixture tests
For median: cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs . && node ground-truth.mjs . -> both print PASS and exit 0; WHY: confirms the median reference solution is self-consistent

For parse-range: cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs . && node ground-truth.mjs . -> both print PASS and exit 0; WHY: confirms the parse-range reference solution is self-consistent

For text-stats: cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs . && node ground-truth.mjs . -> both print PASS and exit 0; WHY: confirms the text-stats reference solution is self-consistent

edge.desc: For each task, the subtle-wrong-output.mjs payload (renamed to solution.mjs) passes acceptance.mjs but FAILS ground-truth.mjs (exit != 0); WHY: validates the fixture design -- the injection must fool the visible test but be caught by the hidden ground-truth, otherwise the experiment harness has no discriminating power
Running acceptance.mjs with no solution.mjs present -> exits non-zero with a clear error; WHY: confirms the test gracefully rejects a missing solution rather than crashing with an unhandled exception

adversarial.desc: After running the self-consistency check, the temporary solution.mjs file is cleaned up (rm solution.mjs) and NOT left tracked in git (git ls-files tasks/*/solution.mjs returns empty); WHY: the verification process itself must not leave dirty state that could be accidentally committed
Running ground-truth.mjs with a zero-byte solution.mjs -> exits non-zero; WHY: a degenerate empty file must not be treated as passing by the ground-truth check

verificationEvidence.command: cd experiments/recovery-runner/tasks/eval-expr && cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs . && node ground-truth.mjs . && rm -f solution.mjs
verificationEvidence.note: eval-expr reference solution self-consistent: ACCEPT PASS (20 checks) + GROUND-TRUTH PASS (9 held-out checks); temp solution.mjs removed.

verificationEvidence.command: cd experiments/recovery-runner/tasks/median && cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs . && node ground-truth.mjs . && rm -f solution.mjs
verificationEvidence.note: median reference solution self-consistent: ACCEPT PASS (8 checks) + GROUND-TRUTH PASS (8 held-out checks); temp solution.mjs removed.

verificationEvidence.command: cd experiments/recovery-runner/tasks/parse-range && cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs . && node ground-truth.mjs . && rm -f solution.mjs
verificationEvidence.note: parse-range reference solution self-consistent: ACCEPT PASS (11 checks) + GROUND-TRUTH PASS (12 held-out checks); temp solution.mjs removed.

verificationEvidence.command: cd experiments/recovery-runner/tasks/text-stats && cp reference-solution.mjs solution.mjs && node acceptance.mjs . && node ground-truth.mjs . && rm -f solution.mjs
verificationEvidence.note: text-stats reference solution self-consistent: ACCEPT PASS (6 checks) + GROUND-TRUTH PASS (5 held-out checks); temp solution.mjs removed.
